description: Product-oriented emulator of frozen v6 conditional on V7 mass-simplex fuels and64 fixed engine sensitivity draws; paired data-only versus physics-informed MLX models; outputs ff,T4,EI-CO2,LCA and domain-limited Brem percent change.
nonclaims: Fuel certification or volume-fraction blend limits
Confidence intervals from conditional fixed draws
Absolute nvPM or mass emission index
An exact v6 physical enthalpy-efficiency balance
Global top-ten verification from a selected-only large-study audit
Physics learning established by an exact postprocessing identity
